text:
emma: heads-up — need to push hotfix v3.2.1 in the 21:00 UTC late window. root cause: embedding service NPE on rare input. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3421

raj: can we canary first? deploy-bot shows canary slots are full in eu-west1.

emma: canary gap adds ~25m and the customer impact is growing. proposal: expedite and skip canary with ops signoff.

deploy-bot: @emma requested manual canary skip. To proceed run: `/deploy start v3.2.1 --pin --skip-canary`. Ops confirmation required.

sam: I'm oncall. quick preflight in staging passed basic smoke. I'm +1 to skip canary if rollback plan is ready.

lina: what's the rollback plan exactly? need a clear single-step command we can run immediately.

sam: rollback plan: `kubectl -n embeddings rollout undo deploy/embeddings-server --to-revision=prev` + deploy-bot hook `/deploy rollback v3.2.1`. keep a watchlist on errors.

ops-oncall: +1 from ops. I ran perf smoke on the canary image in eu-dev, looks stable. Limit burst to 50qps during ramp and monitor.

raj: code change is a single serializer null-check — low risk, fwiw.

deploy-bot: Initiating deploy window at 2026-03-22T21:00Z per request. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/3.2.1. Verifying reserved capacity and pinning.

emma: release notes updated. feature flag will gate the change for 24h in case we need instant rollback toggling.

sam: triggering at T-5. any objections? @emma @lina @ops-oncall

lina: no objections. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy started by sam. Canary skipped per ops consensus. Monitoring posted to channels: #eng-releases, #incidents. Live logs: https://logs.redwood/deploy/7456789012

ops-oncall: smoke ok at T+2m, no error spike, latency stable. keeping watch for the next 15m.

raj: threshold set — if errors > 0.5% for two consecutive 1m windows we rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: v3.2.1 -> prod. No immediate regressions detected. Please complete the post-deploy checklist: release notes update, changelog entry, and customer brief if needed.
